# Prague Metro — Growth Through Time

> An interactive, single-page map of how the Prague Metro grew: every line extension, station
> rename and closure from opening day (9 May 1974) to today, plus Line D under construction
> and its planned phase-II leg. Scrub the timeline or press Play and watch the network grow.
> Free, no account, no ads, no cookies. English.

## What it is
- A history visualisation, not a journey planner: pick any date and see which segments and
  stations were open, how many lines were running, and what changed that year.
- Lines A (green), B (yellow), C (red) as built, Line D in its official blue — dashed where
  under construction, dotted where only planned.
- Station names follow the name valid at the chosen date (renames are events on the timeline).
- Works on a phone: the map fills the width at its native aspect ratio; tap a station for detail.

## How to use it
- https://metro.dravec.org/ — drag the year slider, or press Play; click a station for its
  opening date and renames.

## Data & provenance
- Opening/closure/rename dates compiled from public sources (Dopravní podnik hl. m. Prahy
  history, Wikipedia line/station articles); the dataset is embedded in the page and versioned
  in the repository. Line D dates are the official plan and can slip.
